brief:
Britain's trade envoy to Israel has supported a social media account that disparaged Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband as the "Palestine secretary" and accused Labour of prioritizing Muslim concerns, Middle East Eye reported. The account, known as "Habibi UK," has attacked Miliband and the Labour Party over their approach to Palestinian issues and Muslim representation.

The backing of the troll account by a government trade official raises questions about the boundaries between official diplomacy and partisan social media engagement on contentious Middle East policy questions.

title: UK trade envoy to Israel backs account attacking Miliband over Muslims
